With a small investment of $15,000, she aims to maximize her returns in the volatile stock market. Sarah has developed a new trading algorithm that she believes can outperform the market by identifying trends and executing trades based on historical data.

To validate her strategy, Sarah needs to backtest her algorithm against historical stock prices from the past five years, specifically focusing on tech stocks like Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), and Amazon (AMZN). She requires a smart agent to assist her in this endeavor, as she is unsure of the best practices for backtesting and is concerned about the potential risks associated with algorithmic trading.

Sarah's goal is to determine the average annual return her strategy could have achieved if it had been executed in real-time. She also wants to analyze the maximum drawdown and the Sharpe ratio to assess the risk-adjusted performance of her strategy. With the help of the smart agent, Sarah hopes to refine her trading algorithm and make informed decisions for her upcoming trades.
